notes: §1985:VI.6.17.2 prints INITIALIZE, one or more identifier-1, and an optional REPLACING phrase of one or more items, each item ONE of the five category words (ALPHABETIC, ALPHANUMERIC, NUMERIC, ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED, NUMERIC-EDITED) inside plain braces (§1985:IV.2.1.4: one option), then DATA (optional) BY (required) and identifier-2 or literal-1. The PARTIAL arm (initializeCategory is the 2002 choice-indicator set, so REPLACING NUMERIC ALPHANUMERIC DATA BY ZERO compiled at 85) is fixed by kb/Work PB5180: the construct row initialize-replacing-category-set-2002 refuses the second category word of an item at 85 (COBOL0900, VersionConformancePass.VisitInitializeReplacingItem), and pb415_initialize_multi_category_85 now pins the refusal. The rest was probed right at --std 85 by the 1985 code read: several identifiers, all five categories, DATA omitted; the 2002 phrases refused COBOL0830 to COBOL0833, the later category words COBOL0900, a repeated category COBOL0834.

next.reason: 1985: "REPLACING {ALPHABETIC|ALPHANUMERIC|NUMERIC|ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED|NUMERIC-EDITED} DATA BY"; 2023: "[ WITH FILLER ] [ {ALL|category-name} TO VALUE ] [ THEN REPLACING … ] [ THEN TO DEFAULT ]; category-name adds BOOLEAN, NATIONAL, DATA-POINTER…". 2023 format still accepts every 1985 form but adds the WITH FILLER, TO VALUE and TO DEFAULT phrases and eight more REPLACING categories, so more programs are accepted.
